body.code_violation_desc: The legal use of this building is a single family dwelling with the living areas on the second level and a study, a game room, utility rooms and a garage on the ground level, connected to the second level with a stairway.     Presently, a second dwelling unit has been added to the ground level rooms. A kitchen with a gas stove and a sink, a bathroom and a bedroom have been added. The only entry/egress from the dwelling unit is through the garage or into the back yard.  THE FOLLOWING CODE VIOLATIONS EXIST AT THIS PROPERTY: * WORK WITHOUT PERMIT (SFHC 301, 106a, 108.4.1 SFBC) * UNAPPROVED WIRING (SFHC 1001-e, 110.2 NEC)   * UNAPPROVED PLUMBING (SFHC 1001-f, 102.2 SFPC)   * NO APPROVED PERMANENT SOURCE OF HEAT IN LIVING SPACE (SFHC 701)  * NO APPROVED EMERGENCY EGRESS AT SLEEPING ROOM (SFHC 801)  * CHANGE OF USE WITHOUT PERMIT (3406.1 CBC) * LACK OF PROPER FIRE SEPARATION BETWEEN DWELLING UNITS (SFHC 601) * IMPROPER OCCUPANCY (SFHC 1001-o)

lead hazard warning: disturbing lead based paint can be extremely dangerous to dwelling occupants and visitors, particularly to young children, pregnant women, pets, and to people performing work on the premises. sections 327 of the san francisco building code regulates work that disturbs or removes lead based paint in the interior or exterior of pre-1979 buildings. informational packets available at (415) 558-6088 provide information on notification, performance standards, handling, containment and cleanup requirements for projects involving lead-based paint . you can contact the san francisco childhood lead poisoning prevention program at: (415) 554-8930 for free advice. if you cause lead dust to be created, you could be liable for any illness caused by the dust. ordinance #446-97.
